air-protein.entry_stage_basis: vegconomist (Jan 2021): the $32M Series A was led by ADM Ventures, Barclays and GV; the company was founded in 2019.
air-protein.basis: Still operating (CEO Lisa Dyson profiled by worth.com in Nov 2025) with no priced round after the 2021 Series A. LinkedIn gives HQ 2020 Williams St, San Leandro (the 2020 Form D listed Pleasanton).

amino.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Jul 2014): the $1.65M seed led by Union Square Ventures included Google Ventures; Wikipedia says the same.
amino.basis: Wikipedia: Amino (Narvii) was acquired by MediaLab AI in January 2021. New York-based mobile community app.

arda-therapeutics.entry_stage_basis: Inferred, not named: GV listed Arda by May 2022, the only earlier financing is the Dec 2021 round (Form D, $7.5M sold) that a16z calls the Seed, and GV joined the Oct 2024 Series A as a participant.
arda-therapeutics.basis: Company site: $43M Series A (Oct 2024) led by a16z with GV participating, no valuation disclosed. HQ 1030 Brittan Ave, San Carlos, CA.

benson-hill.entry_stage_basis: AgFunderNews (Oct 2020): GV co-led the $150M Series D and 'also led its Series C'; the Aug 2018 $65M Form D is the first to list GV's Andy Wheeler, the 2017 Series B Form D does not.
benson-hill.basis: Listed via SPAC (NYSE: BHIL) in 2021, filed Chapter 11 in March 2025, and Confluence Genetics bought its assets out of Chapter 11 in May 2025 (Business Wire headline), so an insolvency asset sale.

blue-vision-labs.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Mar 2018): $14.5M Series A led by GV, after a $2.5M seed from Accel, Horizons Ventures and SV Angel.
blue-vision-labs.basis: Crunchbase News (Oct 2018): Lyft acquired the London AR startup for about $72M. It sold a collaborative AR SDK to developers.

cameo.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Mar 2021): Google Ventures joined the $100M Series C led by e.ventures as a new investor.
cameo.basis: The 2021 Series C valued Cameo just over $1B, but TechCrunch (Dec 2024) reports its valuation tanked in a later round, linking The Information's 'Cameo valuation plunges at least 90% in cramdown funding round'. Still operating in 2026 (TikTok and Yahoo tie-ups).

circuithub.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Jan 2013): at launch CircuitHub was backed by Y Combinator with investments from Google Ventures and angels, i.e. its post-YC seed.
circuithub.basis: Raised $28M led by Plural in May 2026 (SiliconANGLE, Tech.eu), valuation undisclosed. The 2026 Form D and LinkedIn give 14 Industrial Drive East, South Deerfield, MA.

creativelive.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Mar 2013): Google Ventures joined CreativeLIVE's Series A (about $8M in total, Greylock led the first $7.5M in Oct 2012) with CAA, WME and CrunchFund.
creativelive.basis: Wikipedia (Chase Jarvis article): Fiverr acquired CreativeLive in October 2021. LinkedIn gives HQ Seattle.

dasient.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Feb 2011): Google Ventures put in undisclosed 'additional funding' after $4M from earlier investors; no source names the round.
dasient.basis: Wikipedia: Sunnyvale anti-malware company acquired by Twitter in January 2012 for $19.1M.

egnyte.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Jul 2012): Egnyte raised $16M from Google Ventures in a Series C with KPCB and Polaris; the 2011 Series B was KPCB-led without GV.
egnyte.basis: Wikipedia and Blocks & Files (Feb 2025): GI Partners and TA Associates took a majority stake (about $1.5B per SaaStr), which GV lists as its exit. Headquartered in Mountain View.

florence.entry_stage_basis: AlleyWatch March 2023 roundup: Florence's $20M round is labelled Seed with Google Ventures among the investors; Fierce Healthcare headline 'Florence picks up $20M backed by Salesforce, GV'.
florence.basis: Florence renamed itself Fabric (florenceos.com redirects to fabrichealth.com) and operates: $60M Series A led by General Catalyst in Feb 2024 with GV as an existing investor, acquisitions into Nov 2025. New York company per AlleyWatch.

flutterflow.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Jan 2024): $25.5M Series A led by GV at about a $170M valuation; GV's AI list dates the first investment 2023-10 and the seed came from YC.
flutterflow.basis: No later round found in news through Sep 2026. YC's page gives San Francisco (offices also in Mountain View, New York and Singapore).

hubspot.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Mar 2011): HubSpot took $32M from Sequoia, Google Ventures and Salesforce after $33M raised earlier (the Series D per Demand Gen Report); GV holds via Google Ventures 2011 L.P.
hubspot.basis: NYSE: HUBS at a $9.92B market cap on Sep 29, 2026 (stockanalysis.com), within 1% of the $10B band edge. SEC address 2 Canal Park, Cambridge, MA.

ipierian.entry_stage_basis: Form D structure: GV's Krishna Yeshwant first appears on the July 2010 round ($29M sold) after two 2009 filings, above the era's Series A band; no source names the round.
ipierian.basis: Bristol-Myers Squibb acquired iPierian in April 2014 (GV exit line; BioSpace gives $725M incl. milestones). Form D address 951 Gateway Blvd, South San Francisco.

juicero.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Mar 2016) lists GV among Juicero's 'Series A and B investors' without saying which round GV entered (Series A Mar 2014, Series B Mar 2016).
juicero.basis: Wikipedia: Juicero suspended sales and ceased operations on Sep 1, 2017 while seeking a buyer; no sale found.

lifemine-therapeutics.entry_stage_basis: The Sep 2017 $55M Series A (company release title; Form D first sale 2017-09-15) is the first filing listing GV's Krishna Yeshwant; the 2016 $5M filing had a single investor.
lifemine-therapeutics.basis: Raised $263M incl. a $188M Series E in Aug 2026 (Crunchbase News) with no valuation disclosed, so below_1b on that note. Company site: HQ in Watertown, MA.

locbox.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Oct 2012): $5.1M Series A led by InterWest with Google Ventures, Accel and 500 Startups participating.
locbox.basis: CelebrityAccess (Oct 2025) bio of founder Saumil Mehta: LocBox, a marketing automation startup, was acquired by Square in 2015. LinkedIn gives San Francisco.

mabl.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Sep 2018): GV led mabl's $20M Series B and Karim Faris joined the board; the Feb 2018 $10M Series A was CRV and Amplify.
mabl.basis: Still operating (agentic testing platform launch, PR Newswire Apr 2026) with no later valuation disclosed. Boston-based per TechCrunch.

modern-age.entry_stage_basis: Glossy (Mar 2024): the $27M Series A (Oct 2021) was led by Oak HC/FT alongside GV and founding partner Juxtapose.
modern-age.basis: Closed in March 2024 (Glossy); WWD (Aug 2024) says ClearMD founder Dr. Ali Rashan bought its IP and reopened the Upper East Side clinic under the Modern Age name, read as an asset sale with the business continuing.

mohawk.entry_stage_basis: Mohawk S-1/A (May 2019): GV's Dave Munichiello joined the Opco board on Mar 6, 2017, the month of the $8.4M Series B, and GV holds via its 2016 and 2017 funds while the Series A dates from 2014.
mohawk.basis: Now Aterian (NASDAQ: ATER) at a $10.38M market cap on Sep 29, 2026 (stockanalysis.com); a Sep 2026 8-K reports a Nasdaq bid-price notice. SEC address 350 Springfield Ave, Summit, NJ.

nimble.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Jan 2012): Nimble 'recently raised a $1 million seed round from Mark Cuban, Google Ventures, and others'.
nimble.basis: Still operating in 2026 (Enterprise Times interview with CEO Jon Ferrara, Sep 2026). Privacy policy address 3122 Santa Monica Blvd, Santa Monica.

overture.entry_stage_basis: GV listed Overture from 2021 and joined a $20.6M round in Apr 2025 (Femtech Insider), but no source names the round GV first entered.
overture.basis: Operating (CE mark Nov 2025, 2026 partnerships), about $57M to $70M raised with no valuation disclosed. An Oct 2025 Business Wire headline calls its new Dallas hub its IVF robotics headquarters; LinkedIn still says Palo Alto, the 2017 Form D New York, and R&D sits in Spain.

plangrid.entry_stage_basis: Wikipedia names YC, Sam Altman, Paul Buchheit and 500 Startups in the seed, Sequoia's $18M Series A (May 2015) and Tenaya's Series B (Nov 2015); none names GV, though GV listed PlanGrid by Oct 2015.
plangrid.basis: Wikipedia: Autodesk acquired PlanGrid for $875M in December 2018. Headquartered in San Francisco.

puppet-labs.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Nov 2011): $8.5M Series C from new investors Cisco, Google Ventures and VMware.
puppet-labs.basis: Wikipedia: Perforce acquired Puppet in April 2022; Puppet Inc. is based in Portland, Oregon.

quettra.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Aug 2014): $2.9M seed round with investors including Google Ventures.
quettra.basis: TechCrunch (Dec 2015): SimilarWeb acquired Quettra, reportedly about $10M in cash and stock. LinkedIn gives 520 San Antonio Rd, Mountain View; it started as a mobile advertising platform.

recorded-future.entry_stage_basis: Wired (Jul 2010): Google Ventures and In-Q-Tel invested in 2009 shortly after founding, under $10M each; no source names the round.
recorded-future.basis: Wikipedia: Insight Partners bought control in 2019 and Mastercard acquired it for $2.65B in 2024; HQ moved from Somerville to downtown Boston in June 2026.

recursive-superintelligence.entry_stage_basis: GV's post (May 2026) says it co-led the 'early $650M funding' without a round label; only a trade outlet (CXO Digitalpulse) called the April $500M tranche 'Pre-Series A'.
recursive-superintelligence.basis: GV's own post: $650M at a $4.65B valuation (May 2026). TechCrunch and LinkedIn describe it as San Francisco-based.

ribon-therapeutics.entry_stage_basis: BioSpace (Jul 2021): GV was a new investor in the $65M round led by Deerfield and USVP, with many existing investors from earlier rounds (five prior Form Ds).
ribon-therapeutics.basis: BioSpace and Boston Business Journal (Aug 2024): Ribon shut down business operations; no asset sale found. Form D and BBJ place it in Cambridge (BioSpace 2021 said Lexington).

rodin-therapeutics.entry_stage_basis: LifeSciVC (Atlas, Nov 2019): after the 2013 seed and 2014 Series A, the 2017 Series B brought in GV, Hatteras, Remeditex and Third Point.
rodin-therapeutics.basis: Alkermes acquired Rodin in Nov 2019 (up to $950M). Form D and LinkedIn say Cambridge, MA; GEN called it Boston-headquartered.

sanas.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Jun 2022): $32M Series A led by Insight Partners with new backer GV; the 2021 $5.5M seed did not include GV.
sanas.basis: TechCrunch (Feb 2025): the $65M Series B values Sanas at over $500M; no later round found. SiliconANGLE: headquartered in Palo Alto.

scalus.entry_stage_basis: No source names GV's round; TechCrunch (Oct 2016) only says the founder's companies raised $10M together from Sherpa Capital, GV, Data Collective and others.
scalus.basis: TechCrunch (Oct 2016): Scalus merged with sister company BackOps into a new company, HireAthena, in 2016 (successor-entity case). LinkedIn: San Francisco, founded 2014.

sidecar.entry_stage_basis: Wikipedia and Forbes (Oct 2012): $10M Series A from Google Ventures and Lightspeed.
sidecar.basis: Wikipedia: Sidecar shut down on Dec 31, 2015 and General Motors acquired its assets and IP in Jan 2016, read as an asset sale out of failure.

spruce-finance.entry_stage_basis: Form D structure: GV's Joe Kraus first appears on Clean Power Finance's Mar 2013 $37M filing after three earlier filings, and GV listed the company by early 2012, so GV entered at the Aug 2011 $19M round or later; no source names the round.
spruce-finance.basis: GV's archived exit line says HPS Investment Partners acquired Spruce in 2018 (the live site's 'Acquired by ShopRunner' contradicts it); XL Fleet then bought Spruce Power in 2022 and became Spruce Power Holding, SEC address Houston.

tenxer.entry_stage_basis: TechCrunch (Apr 2015): tenXer had raised about $5M from True Ventures, Google Ventures and Khosla; no source names GV's round.
tenxer.basis: TechCrunch confirmed Twitter bought tenXer for under $50M and would close the product (Apr 2015). LinkedIn: San Francisco.

tmrw-life-sciences.entry_stage_basis: Femtech Insider (Jul 2021): GV participated in the $105M Series C led by Transformation Capital, listed apart from the existing investors.
tmrw-life-sciences.basis: Femtech Insider (Apr 2026): TMRW combined with Reprotech and the combined company operates under the Reprotech banner; GV lists it as acquired by Reprotech, 2026.

turo.entry_stage_basis: Turo's 2022 S-1 shows GV holding via GV 2010 L.P.; the first round after the 2009 notes is the Dec 2010 Form D listing GV's Joe Kraus, a financing TechCrunch (Oct 2011) calls the Series A.
turo.basis: Last priced round: IAC's $250M Series E (Jul 2019) took Turo 'over the billion-dollar valuation mark' (Auto Rental News); IPO withdrawn Feb 2025 and no later priced round found, so the mark is stale.

upstart.entry_stage_basis: Wikipedia: $1.75M seed from First Round, KPCB, NEA, Google Ventures, CrunchFund and Mark Cuban.
upstart.basis: NASDAQ: UPST at a $2.27B market cap on Sep 29, 2026 (stockanalysis.com). The Q2 2026 10-Q says it is headquartered in Burlingame, CA.

vera-therapeutics.entry_stage_basis: Vera's S-1/A (May 2021): GV 2017 L.P. holds only Series B preferred (GV 2019 holds Series C); Vera was TruCode Gene Repair until its 2020 rename, which explains the archive's TruCode entry.
vera-therapeutics.basis: NASDAQ: VERA at a $2.32B market cap on Sep 29, 2026 (stockanalysis.com). SEC address 2000 Sierra Point Pkwy, Brisbane, CA.
